short: SSL fine-tuning losses (M02) and test-time updates (M03) are standard: SSL-TTT never beats Tent; 0.59 balanced accuracy trails the 82.6% competition winner if scored on its test set.
position: NeuroTTT [@wang2025neurottt] adds domain-specific self-supervised losses to EEG foundation-model fine-tuning (M02) and unlabeled test-time updates (M03). Both are standard. The M02 design is rare in the ledger, but Stage I alone is shown only in a CBraMod figure (Fig. 3) and imagined-speech runs with it train 150 epochs against 100 for supervised runs (Sec. 4.1). The proposed one-step self-supervised test-time training does not beat off-the-shelf Tent on balanced accuracy in any of six backbone-task pairs (Tables 1-3), and five of the six gaps are within the reported spread. The state-of-the-art claim rests on internal baselines: if its test trials are the competition's released set, its best balanced accuracy, 0.5898, is 23.6 points below the 82.6% winner [@jeong2022bcicomp] (inference). Cross-subject gains rest on two and four test subjects with no seeds or significance tests, and test-time cost is not reported (M13).
